title: Core Network Engineer (BGP / MPLS / FTTH)
description: We’re hiring: Core Network Engineer at Ilitha Telecommunications!  Ilitha is on a mission to bridge South Africa’s digital divide by bringing high-speed, affordable fibre (FTTH) and fixed-wireless (WTTX) internet to underserved townships, peri-urban and rural communities. With landmark investment secured to connect over 500,000 low-income homes, we’re scaling fast across the Eastern Cape and beyond, and we need a network engineer to help us build the backbone that makes it happen.  As our Core Network Engineer, you’ll be the person who: - Plans capacity before it becomes a problem, not after - Designs the backhaul routes and PoPs that carry every FTTH and WTTX connection - Owns BGP, OSPF and MPLS, and keeps the backbone fast and secure - Takes the call when the NOC hits something the runbook can’t solve (yes, there’s an on-call rotation)  What we are looking for: 5+ years in an ISP, FTTH operator or telco, a CCNP (or HCIP, MTCRE or JNCIS), and real hands-on time with GPON, DWDM, PPPoE/RADIUS and firewalls. MikroTik and Ubiquiti experience is a bonus. A valid SA driver’s licence is a must, because some of this work happens on site.  This isn’t a role where you maintain what already exists. You’ll help build a network at the moment it’s scaling fastest, for people who really need it.  📍 Rosebank, Gauteng (with site travel) | Permanent, full-time  🗓️ Applications close 20 November 2026  Full job spec on our website: https://lnkd.in/dum97_JS  To apply, email your CV and application letter to Kagiso@ilitha.com with “Core Network Engineer” in the subject line.
